subject: app is not accessible from computers other than mine

messages.author: f2008c6219f50aeb
messages.subject: app is not accessible from computers other than mine
parts:
Hi,

I have built a shiny app that works fine when I access it from my computer (Ubuntu, Firefox) but it does not function properly when accessed from two other computers that I have tried (Windows, Firefox and Mac, Safari). The main page is displayed properly but as soon as I upload an input file, the app stops working. On the Windows machine, the screen turns grey (as when connection to the server is lost) and on the Mac, an error message about invalid 'file' argument is displayed.

Could you please give me a hint what could have gone wrong?

The link to the app: https://sieriebriennikov.shinyapps.io/shiny_ninja_deploy_new/
A sample input .xls file is attached.

Thanks in advance!

Best,
Bogdan
